movements.name: Locked off
movements.prompt: A locked-off camera. Fixed framing throughout; no pan, tilt, zoom or drift.

movements.name: Slow push-in
movements.prompt: A smooth, slow physical dolly-in toward the subject, maintaining the same lens and continuous focus. Gentle foreground parallax.

movements.name: Pull back
movements.prompt: A smooth physical dolly-out from the subject to reveal the surroundings. Keep the subject anchored in frame as the environment opens up.

movements.name: Pan right
movements.effect: Follow a reveal across the scene.
movements.prompt: A controlled pan to the right from a fixed camera position. Smooth constant speed; no lateral camera travel.

movements.name: Pan left
movements.effect: Reveal what lies beyond the frame.
movements.prompt: A controlled pan to the left from a fixed camera position. Smooth constant speed; no lateral camera travel.

movements.name: Tilt up
movements.prompt: A slow upward tilt from a fixed camera position, revealing the subject from lower details to the upper frame.

movements.name: Tilt down
movements.prompt: A slow downward tilt from a fixed camera position, revealing the lower scene with steady smooth movement.

movements.name: Tracking shot
movements.prompt: A smooth lateral tracking shot moving alongside the subject, matching their pace. Maintain consistent framing with clear background parallax.

movements.name: Orbit
movements.effect: Show a subject from a new side.
movements.prompt: A smooth quarter-circle orbit around the subject, keeping them centered. Preserve the world geometry and reveal the changing background naturally.

movements.name: Crane rise
movements.effect: Open up the scene from above.
movements.prompt: A continuous crane rise upward and gently backward, transitioning from eye level to an elevated wide view. Keep the horizon stable.

movements.name: Handheld
movements.effect: Add a human sense of presence.
movements.prompt: Subtle handheld camera movement with natural micro-sway. Controlled and readable, without excessive shake or sudden reframing.

movements.name: Crash zoom
movements.prompt: A rapid optical zoom-in toward the subject, then settle into a stable close-up. The camera remains in place; no physical dolly movement.

movements.name: Dolly zoom
movements.prompt: A deliberate dolly zoom: move the camera backward while optically zooming in, keeping the subject the same size as background perspective compresses.

movements.name: Whip pan
movements.effect: Move abruptly to a new focus.
movements.prompt: A fast whip pan to the right with brief natural motion blur, then settle smoothly on the new subject. One continuous shot.
